spells.name: Conjure Celestial
spells.description: Manifest a 10ft-radius, 40ft-high Cylinder of light. For each creature in it, choose: **Healing Light** (regain 4d12 + spellcasting modifier HP) or **Searing Light** (Dex save or 6d12 Radiant damage, half on success). Move it 30ft when you move (affects creatures once/turn).
spells.upcast: Healing and damage increase by 1d12 per level above 7.

spells.name: Delayed Blast Fireball
spells.description: Create a bead that explodes in a 20ft-radius Sphere for 12d6 Fire damage. Damage increases by 1d6 each turn it's not detonated. If touched, creature makes Dex save or it explodes; if success, they can throw it 40ft.
spells.upcast: Base damage increases by 1d6 per level above 7.

spells.name: Divine Word
spells.description: Chosen creatures make a Charisma save. Fail: if HP <= 50, suffer effect: 0-20 (Die), 21-30 (Blinded/Deafened/Stunned 1h), 31-40 (Blinded/Deafened 10m), 41-50 (Deafened 1m). Extraplanars failing save are banished to home plane for 24h.

spells.name: Etherealness
spells.description: Step into Border Ethereal. See origin plane (gray) up to 60ft. Move in any direction (up/down cost 1:1 extra). Only affect/be affected by Ethereal things. Return to origin plane when ends (shunted if occupied).
spells.upcast: Target three additional willing creatures per level above 7.

spells.name: Finger of Death
spells.description: Force a Constitution save. Fail: 7d8 + 30 Necrotic damage. Success: half damage. Humanoids killed rise as a Zombie permanently under your command.

spells.name: Fire Storm
spells.description: Create storm of up to ten contiguous 10ft Cubes. Each creature makes a Dexterity save or takes 7d10 Fire damage (half on success). Ignites objects.

spells.name: Forcecage
spells.description: Create immobile prison (Cage: 20ft side, bars/gaps; or Box: 10ft side, solid). Blocks matter/spells. Escape via planar travel requires a Charisma save. Cannot be dispelled.

spells.name: Mirage Arcane
spells.description: Transform 1 mile sq area (look/sound/smell/feel). Tactile illusion: can create structures/terrain/hazard. Truesight sees true form but still interacts with illusion.

spells.name: Mordenkainen's Magnificent Mansion
spells.description: Portal (5x10ft) leads to extradimensional home (up to fifty 10ft Cubes). Includes 9-course feast for 100 and 100 phantom servants. You choose who enters.

spells.name: Mordenkainen's Sword
spells.description: Create spectral sword and make melee spell attack within 5ft for 4d12 + spellcasting modifier Force damage. Bonus Action: move 30ft and repeat attack.

spells.name: Plane Shift
spells.description: Teleport up to 8 willing creatures (linking hands) to a different plane or a specific teleportation circle.

spells.name: Power Word Fortify
spells.description: Utter word of power to up to six creatures in range. Each target gains 120 Temporary Hit Points, divided equally among them (min 1).

spells.name: Prismatic Spray
spells.description: Eight rays from your hand. Each creature makes a Dexterity save. Roll d8 for each creature: 1: Red (10d6 Fire), 2: Orange (10d6 Acid), 3: Yellow (10d6 Lightning), 4: Green (10d6 Poison), 5: Blue (10d6 Cold), 6: Indigo (Restrained, then Constitution saves vs Petrified), 7: Violet (Blinded, then Wisdom saves vs Banished), 8: Two rays.

spells.name: Project Image
spells.description: Create illusory copy of yourself at a known location on the same plane. Can see/hear/speak through it. Physical interaction or Study action vs spell DC reveals it as an illusion.

spells.name: Regenerate
spells.description: Target regains 4d8 + 15 HP and 1 HP at start of each of its turns. Severed body parts are restored after 2 minutes.

spells.name: Resurrection
spells.description: Touch dead creature (<100 years). Returns with all HP. Neutralizes poisons/nonmagical diseases. Closes mortal wounds/restores parts. Target has -4 penalty to D20 tests, reduced by 1 per Long Rest. If target has been dead <1 year, you suffer no penalty; if >1 year, you take -4 to D20 tests until Long Rest.

spells.name: Reverse Gravity
spells.description: 50ft-radius, 100ft-high Cylinder reverses gravity. Creatures/objects fall upward. Can make Dexterity save to grab onto fixed objects. When ends, everything falls back down.

spells.name: Sequester
spells.description: Willing creature/object becomes Invisible and enters state of suspended animation. Cannot be seen or detected by Divination (including Scrying). You set a trigger for the spell to end.

spells.name: Simulacrum
spells.description: Create illusory duplicate of a Beast or Humanoid. It has half the target's HP, lacks its gear, and cannot learn or regain slots. Obeys commands; acts on your initiative.

spells.name: Symbol
spells.description: Inscribe symbol (surface/object). Trigger condition (visual/audible). Effects (60ft Sphere): Death (10d10 Necrotic), Discord (Wis save or bicker/argue), Fear (Wis save or Frightened), Hopelessness (Wis save or do nothing), Insanity (Int save or act random), Pain (Con save or Incapacitated), Sleep (Wis save or Unconscious), Stunning (Wis save or Stunned).

spells.name: Teleport
spells.description: Teleport yourself and up to eight willing creatures to a known destination. Accuracy depends on familiarity: Permanent Circle (100%), Associated Object (100%), Very Familiar (1-97%), etc. Misfires cause 3d10 Force damage.

spells.name: Void Star
spells.description: Hurl ball of necrotic energy. Make a ranged spell attack. On hit: 8d10 Necrotic damage and target is Blinded and cannot regain HP until your next turn. Miss: half damage and no other effects.

spells.name: Crown of Stars
spells.description: Seven star-like motes orbit your head. Bonus Action: launch mote (120ft) for ranged spell attack: 4d12 Radiant damage. Sheds 30ft Bright (+30ft Dim) light, reducing as motes are spent.
spells.upcast: Two additional motes for each level above 7.

spells.name: Draconic Transformation
spells.description: Assume draconic power. Gain: **Blindsight** (60ft), **Breath Weapon** (Bonus Action: 60ft cone, Dex save or 6d8 Force damage, half on success), and **Wings** (60ft Fly Speed).

spells.name: Dream of the Blue Veil
spells.description: Teleport up to 8 creatures to a different world in the Material Plane. Requires an item from that world. You fall into a trance; if interrupted, spell fails.

spells.name: Power Word: Pain
spells.description: Target with 100 HP or fewer suffers waves of pain: Speed max 10ft, Disadvantage on attacks/checks/saves, and must pass a Con save to cast spells. Repeat Constitution save at end of turns to end.

spells.name: Temple of the Gods
spells.description: Conjure temple (max 120ft side). Designated creature types cannot enter. You and allies heal extra 1d8 from spells inside. Permanent if cast daily for 1 year.

spells.name: Tether Essence
spells.description: Tether two creatures. Both make a Constitution save (willing can fail). If failed, when one takes damage or heals, the other takes the same amount/heals same amount.

spells.name: Whirlwind
spells.description: 10ft-radius, 30ft-high whirlwind. Creatures make a Dexterity save or take 10d6 Bludgeoning damage and are Restrained. Move it 30ft as an Action.
